God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

translations.web: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
translations.bsb: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
translations.kjv: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
translations.asv: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
